_doc: Wave 7 reference cameras (tools/refcams/README.md), the same format as cameras.json and cameras_w6.json. One row a camera, each on its own line. Run with REFCAMS_JSON=tools/refcams/cameras_w7.json.

cameras.name: bonfire_night
cameras.label: The beach at 21:00 clear among the bonfire rings, groups round the fires, the surf and the pier's lights beyond

cameras.name: canals_day
cameras.label: Marisol Canals at 11:00 clear, on a Heron Canal footbridge looking north down the canal: houses on the water, docks, boats, bridges

cameras.name: port_night
cameras.label: The container terminal at 22:00 clear from the quay's east end inside the crane gauge, looking west: the moored ship and its deckhouse, the working cranes' portals, a tractor under a crane, the floodlit stacks

cameras.name: stack_aerial
cameras.label: The four-level stack (the 110 under the 101) from 150 m up at 17:30 clear, from the north-west toward downtown, traffic on every level

cameras.name: film_lot
cameras.label: Inside the SUNSPIRE PICTURES lot at 14:00 clear, eye level on the studio street between the sound stages, toward the water tower

cameras.name: river_night
cameras.label: The LA River channel at 21:30 clear, on the bed beside the low flow 65 m south of the 6th St ribbon bridge, looking up the channel at its lit arches, the water mirroring them

cameras.name: heli_night
cameras.label: Downtown from a helicopter at 250 m, 22:30 clear, over South Park looking north-west across the lit towers toward the 110 and its traffic streams

cameras.name: metro_station
cameras.label: The Coral Line's underground terminus at 7th St, on the island platform toward the bank's escalators and the lift, a train dwelling on the left with its doors open, riders

cameras.name: lowrider_meet
cameras.label: A Saturday lowrider meet at 19:30 clear on a midtown boulevard kerb (Z#4, x 810-900), eye level in the road beside the row: candy paint and wire wheels, the nearest car three-wheeling, one mid-hop, the crowd on the pavement

cameras.name: hospital_er
cameras.label: The medical centre's ambulance court at 23:00 clear from the ER street: an ambulance backing into a bay under the canopy, the lit EMERGENCY sign, the bed tower behind

cameras.name: terminal_curb
cameras.label: The airport's departures drop-off at 08:00 clear, eye level on the kerb under the terminal's wing roof looking east along the curb: cars and shuttles pulling in, travellers with bags

cameras.name: freight_yard
cameras.label: The Arroyo Pacific freight yard at 16:30 clear, eye level on the ballast where the ladder meets the storage tracks, looking north up the yard: a long train pulling out on the east main, standing cuts, the gantry cranes, container stacks and high masts
